settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHint: Enter your API key. It will be stored locally.
settings.oauthHint: Click "Login" to get the authorization URL. Complete authorization in your browser, then paste the code shown on the page below.
settings.oauthHintOpenAI: Click to get the link, open in browser to sign in with ChatGPT. After authorizing, it will redirect back and complete automatically.
settings.oauthOpenUrl: Open the following URL in your browser to authorize:
settings.oauthPasteCode: After completing authorization in browser, paste the code shown on the page:
settings.oauthDeviceCodeHint: Open the URL above and enter this code on the page to complete authorization. Do not paste it here.
settings.oauthSubmitFailed: Submit failed. Please click "Login with Claude" again to get a new link.
settings.oauthProcessGone: OAuth session expired. Please click "Login with Claude" again.
settings.customProviderAuthHint: Choose according to provider authentication parameters
settings.customProviderModelIdsPlaceholder: Enter model ID, press Enter to add

providerHints.anthropic: Official Anthropic API or Claude Pro/Max subscription
providerHints.openai: OpenAI Codex — GPT-5 series, supports OAuth or API Key
providerHints.deepseek: DeepSeek V3/R1 — native Anthropic-compatible endpoint, no proxy needed
providerHints.qwen: Alibaba Qwen3 Coder — native Anthropic-compatible endpoint via DashScope
providerHints.openrouter: OpenRouter gateway — access 500+ models (OpenAI, Google, DeepSeek, etc.)
providerHints.ollama: Local models via Ollama (v0.14+) — runs on your machine, no API key needed

settings.ollamaNoAuth: Ollama runs locally and does not require authentication.
settings.modelHint: Select the default model for AI tasks
settings.openaiFastModeHint: Official Fast mode only applies with OpenAI OAuth (ChatGPT sign-in) and GPT-5.4. API key mode cannot use Fast mode credits.
settings.openaiFastModeEligibleHint: This configuration can use official Codex Fast mode. It increases speed and consumes credits at a higher rate.
settings.openaiReasoningFallbackHigh: Selected effort not supported by this model, falling back to high
settings.skipPermissionsHint: When enabled, AI can use tools (read/write files, run commands) without manual approval. Disable to require approval for each tool call.
settings.effortLevelHint: Controls the depth of AI reasoning. Higher effort produces more thorough results but takes longer.
settings.maxTurnsHint: Limit the number of agentic turns per conversation. 0 means no limit.
settings.defaultExposePromptPathHint: When creating a new Agent, enable 'Expose Prompt Path' by default, allowing the AI to read and edit its own system prompt. You can still toggle this per Agent.
settings.baseUrlHint: Custom API endpoint for enterprise or proxy setups
settings.noHealthData: No health check data yet. Run a check to see model status.
settings.envOverrideHint: Environment variable {var} is set and will take priority
settings.themeHint: Choose your interface theme. "System" follows your OS settings automatically
settings.dataDirHint: All project data is stored in this directory. Customize via PROJECT_PILOT_DATA_DIR environment variable
settings.exportDataHint: Export all projects, flows, and session data as a JSON file (excludes settings and API keys)
settings.importDataHint: Restore data from a JSON file (current data will be backed up automatically)
settings.confirmImport: Import will overwrite current data (current data will be backed up to _backup directory). Continue?
settings.clearSessionsHint: Delete all task sessions, conversations, and execution plans
settings.confirmClearSessions: Are you sure you want to clear all session data? Current data will be backed up first.
settings.confirmClearFlows: Are you sure you want to clear all flow data? Current data will be backed up first.
settings.confirmClearAll: Are you sure you want to clear all data? Current data will be backed up first.
settings.dataStorageInfo: All data is stored locally on your device and never uploaded to any server. API keys are stored in plaintext in local JSON files — please ensure your device is secure.
settings.telemetryHint: The current version does not collect any telemetry or usage data. This toggle is reserved for future versions.
settings.openSourceInfo: ProjectPilot is open source — the code is fully transparent and auditable.
settings.safetyDetectionHint: Detects dangerous operations when AI executes Bash commands. Detection happens AFTER execution: "Terminate" kills the session process, "Warn" shows a UI notification, "Off" disables detection.
settings.dangerDataDirectoryHint: Detect write/delete operations to the ProjectPilot data directory
settings.dangerFileDestructiveHint: Detect rm -rf, del /s and other recursive delete operations
settings.dangerGitDangerousHint: Detect git push, force push, reset --hard, branch -D, etc.
settings.satelliteTasksEnabledHint: Master switch for post-run hooks such as title generation, health guard, knowledge extraction, and task card updates.
settings.schedulesPageEnabledHint: Controls whether the scheduled tasks entry and page are available in Flows. Direct access is also blocked when disabled.
settings.taskTriggersPageEnabledHint: Controls whether the event-driven task trigger entry and page are available in Flows. Direct access is also blocked when disabled.
settings.satelliteTasksInternalHint: This area is for developer-side workflow hooks. Turning the switch off preserves task settings, but no satellite task will run until re-enabled.
settings.titleGenerationHint: Automatically generates or updates session titles using a cheap AI model at turns 2, 5, 10, and 15.
settings.titleGenerationEnabledHint: When disabled, session titles will use the first 30 characters of the user message.
settings.titleGenerationChainHint: Tried in order — if one fails, the next is attempted. Each entry has an 8-second timeout.
settings.titleGenerationChainEmpty: No entries. Default config will be used (Anthropic Claude Haiku).
